title: Viva Glint: customise the Teams survey notifications
summary: The briefing accurately separates planned Teams notification editing from the currently documented notification controls. The roadmap details, licensing prerequisites and both control paths are supported; the preview checklist item has no corresponding controls-table row.

claims.claim: The roadmap plans customisation of Teams survey notifications by Viva Glint admins.
claims.quote: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys.

claims.claim: The planned editing includes the notification title.
claims.quote: Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language

claims.claim: The planned editing includes the notification message.

claims.claim: The planned editing includes the notification button label.

claims.quote: and see their changes in a live preview.

claims.claim: The roadmap's stated aim is consistency between Teams and email messages and the organisation's voice.
claims.quote: Teams and email messages stay consistent and match your organization's voice

claims.claim: The roadmap attributes improved survey visibility and participation to the change.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe the planned Teams notification editing feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization edit title message button label default enable roles permissions. Opened glint-teams, glint-teams-previews and email-content-customization; Teams editing remains documented as unsupported.

claims.where: What's changing; Why it matters; changes
claims.claim: The Teams notifications page currently says editing Teams notification content is unsupported.
claims.quote: Viva Glint survey notifications in Teams don't currently support: - Edits to Teams notification content.

claims.claim: The Teams communications preview page also says editing notification content is unsupported.
claims.quote: Edits to Teams notification content aren't currently supported.

claims.where: What's changing; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Viva Glint documents previews of Teams invites, reminders and survey results notifications.
claims.quote: Preview Microsoft Teams survey notifications (invites, reminders, results notifications) in the Microsoft Viva Glint app.

claims.claim: Email content for survey invites, reminders and results notifications can already be customised.
claims.quote: Customize Microsoft Viva Glint email content for survey invites, reminders, and survey results notifications in the Communications section of Program Setup.

claims.claim: Email content editing is in the Communications section of the desired survey program's Program Summary.
claims.quote: To edit email content, go to the Communications section of Program Summary in your desired survey program.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Teams must be enabled in General Settings to make it an organisation-wide notification option.
claims.quote: In General Settings, to have Teams as a notification option overall for your organization.

claims.where: What's changing; Scope; controls[1]; Governance controls; rationale: impact
claims.claim: Admins enable Teams as a notification channel separately for each survey program.
claims.quote: In the Communications tab for each survey that should include Teams notifications.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Teams notifications use each user's configured Viva Glint survey language.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams notifications from Viva Glint are automatically delivered in the user's survey language configured in Viva Glint.

claims.where: What's changing; Risk assessment: Change & support; Open questions
claims.claim: A survey language unsupported for Teams notifications falls back to English (en-US).
claims.quote: If a user's survey language is not supported for Teams notifications, the notification is sent in English (en-US).

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described how edited Teams text interacts with the language fallback.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customized content HTML hyperlinks language fallback Communications editing. Opened glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; they document language fallback but say Teams content edits are unsupported.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters; Open questions; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the default state of the new editing feature.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization edit title message button label default enable roles permissions. Read roadmap record, glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; none states the new editor's default or activation requirement.

claims.where: Why it matters; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: The roadmap describes admin edits rather than automatic changes to existing notification content.
claims.quote: Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language and see their changes in a live preview.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; rationale: risk
claims.claim: The roadmap describes notification text editing and does not describe new data access.
claims.quote: Viva Glint admins can now customize the Microsoft Teams notifications sent for surveys. Admins can edit the title, message, and button label in each survey language and see their changes in a live preview.

claims.claim: Hyperlinks and HTML are not supported content in customised Viva Glint emails.
claims.quote: Hyperlinks and HTML aren't supported content in Viva Glint customized emails. These items can cause email delivery or blocking issues.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether the email hyperlinks and HTML rule applies to the planned Teams editing.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customized content HTML hyperlinks language fallback Communications editing. Opened email-content-customization, glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; the restriction describes emails, not the planned Teams editor.

claims.claim: Recipients need the Viva Glint app installed in Teams.
claims.quote: Use the information in this article to have a Microsoft 365 admin install Viva Glint for Teams users in your organization and to enable Teams in the Viva Glint application.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Organisations using app-centric management centrally install apps through Manage apps.
claims.quote: If your organization uses app centric management functionality, then use Manage apps page to install agents and apps for users.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance controls
claims.claim: Organisations not using app-centric management can preinstall apps using setup policies.
claims.quote: Otherwise, continue to preinstall agents and apps using setup policies.

claims.claim: A notification enabled or queued at the cycle level takes precedence over the program-level setting.
claims.quote: If a notification is enabled or queued at the cycle level, it will take precedence over the program-level setting.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Scope; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Teams should be enabled before the survey launches.
claims.quote: Enable Teams before a survey launches.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance guidance: At rollout
claims.claim: Enabling Teams after a survey is live does not send survey notifications in Teams.
claims.quote: Enabling this feature after a survey is live doesn't send survey notifications in Teams.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Using Viva Glint requires a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan.
claims.quote: The purchase of a Viva Suite or Viva Glint subscription plan is required for using Microsoft Viva Glint.

claims.claim: The number of active subscription licences should be at least the number of active app users.
claims.quote: The total number of active licenses in your subscriptions should be greater than or equal to the number of active users in the app.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Individual user licence assignment is not required for using Viva Glint.
claims.quote: Individual user license assignment isn't required for using Viva Glint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Users need individual Microsoft Teams licences to receive Viva Glint notifications in Teams.
claims.quote: users need to have individual Microsoft Teams licenses to receive Viva Glint notifications there.

claims.claim: The briefing describes the published licensing requirement as per-user, without individual Viva Glint assignment.
claims.quote: The total number of active licenses in your subscriptions should be greater than or equal to the number of active users in the app. Individual user license assignment isn't required for using Viva Glint.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No licence specific to editing Teams notifications is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization licensing pricing meter subscription. Opened glint-order-teams, glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; found product and Teams licence requirements, not an editing-specific licence.

claims.claim: No meter specific to editing Teams notifications is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization licensing pricing meter subscription. Opened glint-order-teams, glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; no editing-specific meter was documented.

claims.claim: No price specific to editing Teams notifications is published as of November 2026.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization licensing pricing meter subscription. Opened glint-order-teams, glint-teams and glint-teams-previews; no editing-specific price was documented.

claims.claim: The documented organisation switch selects Teams as a notification option, rather than editing notification content.
claims.quote: In General Settings, to have Teams as a notification option overall for your organization. Viva Glint survey notifications in Teams don't currently support: - Edits to Teams notification content.

claims.claim: Learn currently says Viva Glint Teams notifications are not supported in GCC.
claims.quote: Notifications in Teams for Viva Glint are currently not supported in GCC environments.

claims.claim: Always-On surveys do not have a Communications section.
claims.quote: Always-On surveys don't include a Communications section or any notifications.

claims.claim: Always-On surveys do not send notifications, including Teams messages.
claims.quote: Always-On surveys don't include a Communications section or any notifications. Emails and Microsoft Teams messages aren't available for this survey type.

claims.claim: Teams notifications do not currently support 360 feedback notifications.
claims.quote: Viva Glint survey notifications in Teams don't currently support: ... 360 feedback notifications.

claims.claim: Teams notifications do not currently support cross-tenant notifications in Microsoft 365 multitenant organisations.
claims.quote: Notifications across multiple tenants for organizations that use Microsoft 365's multitenant organization feature.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the Viva Glint role required for the new Teams content editor.
claims.quote: Searched: Viva Glint Teams notification customization edit title message button label default enable roles permissions. Opened glint-order-teams and glint-teams; read Key roles for Viva Glint search excerpt. No new-editor role requirement was stated.

claims.claim: The organisation toggle is at Viva Glint > Configuration > Service Configuration > General Settings > Communications > Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol and in the Service Configuration section, choose General Settings. In the Communications section, switch the Microsoft Teams toggle to Yes.

claims.claim: The survey toggle is at Viva Glint > Configuration > Surveys > Survey Programs > survey > Communications > Channels > Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: Select the Configuration symbol and in the Surveys section choose Survey Programs. Select a survey and go to the Communications section. In the Channels section, switch the Microsoft Teams toggle to On.

claims.claim: Teams app setup policies are located at Teams admin center > Teams apps > Setup policies.

claims.claim: A Teams Administrator or an admin with a higher role can manage app setup policies.
